paths.new_costs_and_risks: Preparation time is spent even if the event succeeds.
paths.assumption: Course instructors will distribute the survey link in class.
paths.event: Most instructors decline, and distribution shrinks to a single mailing list.
paths.mechanism: One low-response channel cannot reach the pre-registered sample size in the approval window.
paths.early_signal: Fewer than 30 responses after the first two weeks.
paths.consequence: The study closes underpowered and the semester of approval is spent.
paths.stop_condition: If responses are below 100 by week six, stop and redesign rather than extend silently.

plan.plan: Complete a survey study of first-year students within one semester.
plan.success: At least 300 valid responses with the pre-registered analysis run.
plan.failure: Response count stays below the pre-registered minimum or ethics approval lapses.
plan.hard_constraints: Ethics approval covers one semester only; no incentives budget.
